headers:
1. SEE LUMINAIRE SCHEDULE ON SHEET E1.2 ELECTRICAL LIGHTING - PHOTOMETRIC PLAN FOR SELECTED LIGHT FIXTURES.
2. ALL SITE LIGHTING SHALL BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH, LEE COUNTY, FLORIDA LAND DEVELOPMENT CODE, MUNICIPAL CODE SEC. 34-625. - OUTDOOR LIGHTING STANDARDS.
3. ALL EXISTING AND CIVIL CONDITIONS TO BE FIELD VERIFIED PRIOR TO START OF WORK.
4. ALL ELECTRICAL WORK SHALL BE IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE 2023 FLORIDA BUILDING CODE, 2020 NEC AND ALL OTHER APPLICABLE CODES AND ORDINANCES.
5. CONTRACTOR SHALL INSTALL A GREEN EQUIPMENT GROUNDING WIRE IN ALL CONDUITS AND SHALL BOND THE GROUND WIRE TO ALL DEVICES AND ELECTRICALLY WIRED
EQUIPMENT. GROUNDING AND BONDING SHALL BE INSTALLED IN ACCORDANCE WITH NATIONAL ELECTRIC CODE, ARTICLE 250.
6. LIGHT FIXTURES ARE SELECTED FOR PHOTOMETRIC PERFORMANCE, QUALITY, AND AESTHETICS. SUBSTITUTIONS REQUIRE FIXTURE SUBMITTALS AND PHOTOMETRIC DATA AT
LEAST 10 DAYS PRIOR TO BID DATE. WRITTEN APPROVAL IS REQUIRED BY THE ENGINEER PRIOR TO BID DATE.
7. EXISTING SITE LIGHTING CONTROLS ARE PROVIDE VIA EXISTING TIMECLOCK AND SHALL REMAIN. ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR SHALL CONNECT NEW SITE LIGHTING TO EXISTING
CONTROLS AND TEST.
8. PRIOR TO ORDERING MATERIALS AND EQUIPMENT, CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE SUBMITTALS FOR ALL ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT AND MATERIAL PROVIDED IN THIS PROJECT.
SUBMITTALS SHALL INCLUDE SPECIFICATION SHEETS FOR ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT. WRITTEN APPROVAL BY THE ENGINEER-OF-RECORD IS REQUIRED PRIOR TO ORDERING
EQUIPMENT.
9. SEE ELECTRICAL FEEDER SCHEDULES INDICATING WIRE, FEEDER AND CONDUCTOR SIZING.
10. PROVIDE HOUSE SIDE SHIELD FOR LIGHT FIXTURES AROUND PERIMETER OF PROPERTY AS NECESSARY TO HAVE 0 FOOT CANDLES OF LIGHTING AT BOUNDARY.
11. PROVIDE ACCEPTABLE LIGHT POLE FOR APPLICATION AND FIXTURE MOUNTING.

12. THE ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR INCLUDING ALL ACCEPTABLE POLES, STRUCTURES, BASE SUPPORTS, CONCRETE SUPPORTS, AND MOUNTING
SYSTEMS FOR SITE LIGHTING. COORDINATION WITH THE CM AND THE LIGHTING MANUFACTURER IS REQUIRED PRIOR TO BIDDING, SUBMITTALS AND PURCHASING. PROVIDE
ANCHORAGE FOR MOUNTING SITE POLES IN COMPLIANCE WITH FBC WIND SPEEDS AND IN ACCORDANCE WITH MANUFACTURERS INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS. PROVIDE
CONCRETE FOR EMBEDDING POLES IF REQUIRED TO WITHSTAND WIND LOADS.
13. ALL SITE LIGHT POLES SHALL BE HURRICANE RATED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE RISK CATEGORY AND WIND LOADS FOR PROJECT LOCATION.
14. THE LIGHTING CIRCUITS SHOWN ARE DIAGRAMMATIC AND REPRESENT THE DESIGN INTENT ONLY. ACTUAL FIELD CONDITIONS MUST BE VERIFIED AND LIGHTING CIRCUITS
ADJUSTED ACCORDINGLY TO ENSURE COMPLIANCE WITH THE DESIGN INTENT, INCLUDING PROPER POWER DISTRIBUTION AND CONTROL INTEGRATION.
15. ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR NOTE: THE ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR SHALL FIELD-VERIFY THAT THE EXISTING SITE LIGHTING POLES AND FIXTURES INDICATED ON THE DRAWINGS ARE
CONNECTED TO THE CIRCUITS SHOWN ON THE PLANS. CONTRACTOR SHALL CONFIRM ACTUAL CIRCUITING IN THE FIELD AND MAKE ANY NECESSARY ADJUSTMENTS TO WIRE SIZES,
CONDUIT SIZES, BREAKERS, AND ASSOCIATED COMPONENTS TO PROVIDE A FULLY OPERATIONAL SITE LIGHTING SYSTEM.
· INCLUDE IN THE BID ALL ASSUMPTIONS REQUIRED TO MODIFY THE EXISTING ELECTRICAL SYSTEM FOR PROPER PERFORMANCE. THE BID SHALL ALSO PROVIDE A SEPARATE
LINE-ITEM COST FOR THE COMPLETE INSTALLATION OF EACH SITE LIGHTING FIXTURE TYPE SPECIFIED IN THESE DOCUMENTS (FIXTURES W, S1, AND S2).
16. PROVIDE NEW BELOW GRADE PULL BOXES FOR POWER WIRING AT EACH NEW LIGHT.
17. PROVIDE NEW BELOW GRADE PULL BOXES FOR LOW VOLTAGE AV/TELECOMMUNICATION WIRING AT EACH NEW LIGHT POLE WITH CAMERAS AND LOW VOLTAGE EQUIPMENT
ATTACHED TO THE POLE.
18. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL TEST ALL EXISTING LOW-VOLTAGE SYSTEMS AND CAMERAS CONNECTED TO THE NEW LIGHT POLES. A REPORT SHALL BE PROVIDED CONFIRMING THAT
ALL EXISTING LOW-VOLTAGE SYSTEMS AND CAMERAS HAVE BEEN TESTED AND ARE IN PROPER WORKING ORDER. THE OWNER OR ENGINEER MUST APPROVE THE REPORT PRIOR
TO FINAL PAYMENT.
19. ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE ALL REQUIRED CONTACTORS, RELAYS, ACCESSORIES, AND RELATED COMPONENTS NECESSARY TO ENSURE A FULLY OPERATIONAL
LIGHTING CONTROL SYSTEM. WHERE CONNECTED LOAD OR AMPERAGE EXCEEDS THE RATING OF TIME CLOCKS, PHOTOCELLS, OR OTHER CONTROL DEVICES, THE ELECTRICAL
CONTRACTOR SHALL FURNISH APPROPRIATELY SIZED CONTACTORS OR AUXILIARY EQUIPMENT. COORDINATE ALL ELECTRICAL AND CONTROL REQUIREMENTS WITH THE LIGHT
FIXTURES AND ASSOCIATED SYSTEMS.

1. REMOVE EXISTING PULL BOX AND PROVIDE NEW GROUND PULL BOX(S) IN GENERAL LOCATION INDICATED. PROVIDE A SINGLE PULL BOX FOR POWER
AND SINGLE PULL BOX FOR LOW VOLTAGE WIRING FOR THE LOW VOLTAGE DEVICES, AS APPLICABLE. DISCONNECT EXISTING LOW-VOLTAGE SYSTEMS
AND CAMERAS FROM THE EXISTING LIGHT POLES AND RECONNECT THEM TO THE NEW LIGHT POLES IN THE SAME CONFIGURATION AS EXISTING,
WHETHER OR NOT SHOWN ON THE DRAWINGS. PROVIDE NEW LOW-VOLTAGE WIRING, CONDUIT, AND COMPONENTS AS REQUIRED FOR A FULLY
OPERATIONAL LOW-VOLTAGE SYSTEM. REMOVE EXISTING SITE LIGHT FIXTURE AND POLE, AND CAP EXISTING WIRING FOR FUTURE USE. PROVIDE NEW
SITE LIGHTING FIXTURE, POLE AND CONCRETE BASE SUPPORT. INSTALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH MANUFACTURERS INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS.
EXTEND EXISTING POWER AND WIRING TO SERVE NEW LIGHT FIXTURE. VERIFY EXACT REQUIREMENTS WITH MANUFACTURER'S NAMEPLATE.
2. DISCONNECT AND REMOVE EXISTING CAMERAS, WIRING, CONDUIT, AND ASSOCIATED LOW VOLTAGE SYSTEMS ATTACHED TO THE EXISTING LIGHT
POLE. REMOVE EXISTING LOW VOLTAGE WIRING TO POINT REQUIRED FOR THE INSTALLATION OF THE NEW SITE LIGHT POLE. PROVIDE NEW GROUND
PULL BOX FOR LOW VOLTAGE WIRING AND RE-WIRE TO EXISTING CAMERAS AND LOW VOLTAGE EQUIPMENT. ATTACH THE EXISTING CAMERAS AND LOW
VOLTAGE SYSTEMS TO THE NEW SITE LIGHT POLE, SAME AS EXISTING. PROVIDE AS NECESSARY NEW WIRING, CONDUIT, AND COMPONENTS, SAME AS
EXISTING, FOR A COMPLETELY OPERATIONAL LOW VOLTAGE SYSTEM.
